create_gcs_bucket: create a GCS bucket with an optional location using the GCSGateway class
upload_file_to_gcs: upload a local file to a GCS bucket at a specified key path
download_file_from_gcs: download a file from a GCS bucket to a local file path
list_gcs_objects: list all objects in a GCS bucket filtered by a prefix key
copy_gcs_object: copy an object from one GCS bucket to another bucket with a new key
